reviewerIndependence.basis: The independent reviewer is a different canonical human from every case contributor, from every observed analyst and from every service identity. An alias of the same person is the same human.

documentFieldGuidance.releaseFingerprint: Exact 64-hex candidate source fingerprint from the regenerated release ledger; a new candidate invalidates this record
documentFieldGuidance.caseContributorHumanIds: Canonical human identities that authored case content in the observed cases
documentFieldGuidance.observer: The appointed observer who ran the sessions and attests the observations
documentFieldGuidance.reviewerIndependence: The independent-reviewer assertion required by A19; every observed reviewer must be named here
documentFieldGuidance.assistiveTechnologyEvidence: One real assistive-technology pass with an appropriate user or specialist; a simulated pass is not coverage
documentFieldGuidance.status: OBSERVED only when real sessions were recorded; NOT_RUN otherwise
documentFieldGuidance.synthetic: False only for records from real human observation

sessionRecordFields.participantId: Consented anonymous identifier; omit personal names
sessionRecordFields.canonicalHumanId: Opaque canonical identity; aliases remain the same person

consent.obtained: true once the participant consented to this observation
consent.scope: What the participant agreed to be observed and recorded

sessionRecordFields.explanation: Participant explanation of exact area/period, coverage and uncertainty
sessionRecordFields.outcome: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED; a failed or blocked journey is recorded and reported, never rejected

corrections.task: Task id of the failed journey

tasks.task: Workflow check id from the qualification profile, or an additional journey id
tasks.attempts: Assigned attempts for this participant and task
tasks.completedUnassisted: Attempts that completed with no developer assistance
tasks.assistedCompletions: Attempts that completed only with developer assistance
tasks.wrongAreaOrWrongPeriod: true when any attempt concluded with the wrong area or period
tasks.coverageVersusAbsenceExplained: true when the participant correctly explained coverage versus absence
tasks.resultAndReviewStateExplained: true when the participant correctly explained the result state and review state
tasks.critical: true for a critical journey under A19
tasks.retested: true when the failed journey was repaired and retested
